استحيين (form X)
# اِسْتَحْيَيْنَ (istaḥyayna) /is.taħ.jaj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَحْيَا (istaḥyā)
# اُسْتُحْيِينَ (ustuḥyīna) /us.tuħ.jiː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَحْيَا (istaḥyā)
# اِسْتَحْيِينَ (istaḥyīna) /is.taħ.jiː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَحْيَا (istaḥyā)
